HomeHero.subtitle: A psychologist for children, children with special needs and parents
HomeHero.p1: I help a child understand themselves, their emotions and needs better – and help parents understand their child better.
HomeHero.p2: I work with anxiety, crisis states, emotional and behavioural difficulties, developmental and interaction features.
HomeHero.p3: An individual approach to every child, every story and every family.
HomeHero.photoCaption: Practising psychologist | Creator of EMO therapy

HomeAbout.h2: A child needs time, patience and truth
HomeAbout.p1: Years of practice have convinced me: a child opens up where they feel safety, acceptance, sincerity and trust. That is what builds value. So my work begins with careful observation and a deep understanding of the child – their emotions, needs, traits and inner world.
HomeAbout.p2: I work with emotions, behaviour, anxiety, fears and crisis states. And always alongside parents: helping them understand their child, build close and effective contact, and find their own inner ground in parenthood.
HomeAbout.p3: My approach is individual. My goal is to help a child restore inner balance, understand themselves better and unfold their potential – and to help the family find its own path to mutual understanding.

HomeServices.h2: Formats of work – for the child, the parents and professionals
HomeServices.p: I work with families, teenagers, women and colleagues. Choose the format that feels closer to you – we will discuss the rest at our first meeting.
HomeServices.ctaNote: Not sure which format is yours? Write to me – I will help you choose

joint.title: Joint session
joint.subtitle: Both parents or one parent + a child aged 10 and up.
points: Talking together: the family request, the atmosphere at home and expectations from the work.
Talking with parents: how the adults see the situation, the child’s development and history.
Talking with the child: making contact, getting to know their view of the situation, emotions and needs.
Observation: analysing interaction, emotional bonds and non-verbal signals between parents and child for further recommendations.

parents.title: Consultation for parents
parents.subtitle: Without the child.
points: Analysing the child’s behaviour: the causes of difficulties, emotional reactions and the signals a child sends through behaviour.
Aligning positions: helping parents reach a common view and form a single approach to parenting.
A strategy: no more acting at random – a clear plan and rules for your specific situation.
Support for parents: space to voice your own feelings, release tension and find inner ground.

teens.title: Consultation for teenagers
teens.subtitle: From 12 years old.
points: A safe space: an atmosphere of trust and acceptance where a teenager can speak openly about what troubles them, without fear of judgement.
Working with emotions and anxiety: understanding one’s feelings, lowering stress, overcoming fears and self-regulating.
Self-esteem and self-expression: finding inner supports, self-acceptance, building confidence and understanding one’s boundaries and values.
Relationships and adaptation: support in resolving conflicts with peers or parents, moving through life crises and finding personal meaning.

women.title: Consultations for women
women.subtitle: One to one, online or in person.
points: Emotional support and resourcing: moving through stress, anxiety and burnout, restoring a sense of inner ground and emotional resource.
Self-esteem and self-expression: working with self-worth, building confidence, setting personal boundaries and accepting your individuality.
Relationships and safety: support in difficult relationships, processing abuse and violence, ending toxic bonds and moving to a new level of life. Building healthy communication skills.
Life crises and the search for meaning: support through difficult transformations, help with important decisions, choosing your own path and finding new landmarks.

professionals.title: Sessions for professionals: group and private
professionals.subtitle: Psychologists, teachers, social and special-needs educators, rehabilitation specialists.
points: EMO therapy – the toy, the stories, the metaphorical cards and tokens: mastering the method in practice, bringing the cards into your sessions, effective ways to support clients and turning therapeutic work into play.
The ТМ «Enot EMO» learning and therapy toy: a methodological guide and algorithms for using the toy and its manuals in correctional and therapeutic work.
Professional growth and brand: building a personal brand as a helping professional, positioning and promoting your services.
Intervision and support: reviewing difficult client cases among colleagues, finding new therapeutic solutions and preventing burnout.

training.title: Training online and in person
training.subtitle: For parents and for professionals.
points: Formats and materials: courses, masterclasses and workshops – live or recorded, with ready-made working materials and guides.
Training for parents: practical webinars and programmes that help you understand children, their emotions and development better.
Training for colleagues: professional programmes for helping professionals on new methods and practical tools.

onsite.title: On-site trainings and seminars on request
onsite.subtitle: At the client’s venue.
points: In-person work and practice: live sessions, interactive lectures and workshops at your venue for full immersion in the topic.
An individual programme: content adapted to the team’s request – for parent communities, schools, kindergartens or professional teams.
Practical tools: learning working techniques of emotional self-regulation, overcoming burnout and effective communication right during the meeting.
Team support: a safe space to share experience, bring the team together and get professional answers to current questions.

groups.title: Group formats and communities
groups.subtitle: Small groups, online or in person.
points: Psychotherapeutic or support groups for women and parents: regular online or in-person meetings in small groups (6–8 people) on shared topics – burnout, boundaries in relationships, anxiety, self-esteem.
Teen psychology clubs and trainings: group sessions on soft skills, emotional intelligence, self-confidence, communication with peers and coping with stress.

mentoring.title: Specialised ongoing support
mentoring.subtitle: Long-term individual support.
points: Mentoring for professionals: long-term individual support for early-career colleagues – from mastering EMO therapy in depth to growing your own practice and guiding your first client cases.

Family support package: a complete solution for 1–3 months including joint sessions, separate consultations for the child and the parents, and ongoing text support in a messenger for crisis situations.

HomeMethod.h2: EMO therapy: developing emotional intelligence in children and teenagers
HomeMethod.p: EMO therapy is a unique original system where the toy, the stories, the tokens, the cards and the manuals work as one. A child learns to recognise, express and live through their emotions in play, while the adult gets clear and workable ways to support them.
